references.text: Moses also sent men to explore the land of Canaan, a similar mission to investigate and report back on the land.
Moses gave orders to distribute the land as an inheritance among the tribes, the same theme of inheritance distribution found in Joshua.
Describes how the land was distributed as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, the same context as the distribution in chapter 18.
The men who were sent went through the land, wrote it down, and returned to Joshua, a direct fulfillment of the command in verse 4.
The conclusion of the inheritance distribution that began with the sending of men to map out the land.
Instructions on how the land should be distributed as an inheritance according to the size of each tribe.
